implementation.zeroHandling: Add a very small unspecified value when S entry is zero

formulaAudit.equation26: For equation24 sum(S^q), derivative is q*S^(q-1); printed update coefficient lambda/2 matches only q=1/2 under same lambda definition. No claim that authors ran incorrect code or official erratum exists.
formulaAudit.fixedSConvexity: Fixed A, positive scalar case can have negative second derivative; contradicts general convex-in-each-variable wording on page6. This does not by itself disprove multiplicative-update descent.
formulaAudit.stopping: Two distinct criteria printed on page9; initialization unit norm is unspecified.
formulaAudit.complexity: Page10 assigns O((KN)^2) to elementwise S^-1/2; one elementwise pass has KN operations under constant-cost scalar arithmetic. Full iteration also has matrix multiplications; no runtime experiment conducted.
formulaAudit.convergenceBoundary: Read auxiliary-function proof, but no independent full proof or implementation validation; threshold-dependent omission and zero handling need separate implementation analysis.

independentMathProbe.boundary: Scalar positive-domain calculus only; no implementation, convergence, or benchmark reproduction.
